self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Bane of the Swirling Mortal (R1): DMG dealt to opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro is increased by 20%.

en.flavor: A polearm decorated with an entwining golden dragon. Light and sharp, this weapon may very well kill dragons with ease.

refinements.1: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro by <r>20%</r>.
refinements.2: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro by <r>24%</r>.
refinements.3: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro by <r>28%</r>.
refinements.4: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro by <r>32%</r>.
refinements.5: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Pyro by <r>36%</r>.

fr.flavor: Une lance aussi légère que pointue sur laquelle s'enroule un dragon d'or. Légère et affûtée, cette arme pourrait fort bien être capable de tuer des dragons.
